pass: MD re-seat candidates from mig 1736 resolved by reading the rest of each record
note: rows = the 3 now seated + sourced (the --check gate reads these). not_seated = deliberately left blank.
correction: Hester chair 4 was CORRECT. The earlier "re-seat to ch3" rested on 3 fetched bills; the 2 unfetched ones (SB0905, SB0141) are prohibitions on high-risk AI uses. An absence built on an unread record is not a finding.

rows.name: Katie Fry Hester
rows.prior_reasoning: Hester introduced 2026 bills to ban election-related deepfakes, criminalize deepfake impersonation causing serious harm, and restrict minors from unsafe AI chatbots. Her deepfake election bill passed the Senate unanimously.

rows.name: Cheryl C. Kagan
rows.prior_reasoning: Kagan has been a consistent advocate for campaign finance transparency and reform, supporting disclosure requirements and limits on dark money in Maryland elections.

rows.name: Benjamin F. Kramer
rows.prior_reasoning: Kramer supports expanding Medicaid and protecting Medicare. He has backed healthcare safety net programs serving vulnerable populations in his district.

not_seated.name: Sara Love
not_seated.why: The ladder asks WHO draws the maps; her bills (HB0463 2019, HB1431 2020) set district STANDARDS and an open hearing process and leave the General Assembly drawing. No commission, no supermajority committee, no court-oversight mechanism — no chair is described.
